A side-by-side diagram. On the left, a "Transverse Wave" shown on a rope, with an arrow pointing right for "Wave Direction" and an up-down double arrow for "Particle Vibration", labelling crest and trough. On the right, a "Longitudinal Wave" shown on a slinky spring, with an arrow pointing right for "Wave Direction" and a left-right double arrow for "Particle Vibration", labelling compressed rings as "Compression" and stretched rings as "Rarefaction". Clean flat textbook illustration, white background.

A 3D view of a basic ripple tank apparatus. A shallow rectangular glass tray containing water stands on legs. Above it, a light bulb points downward. On the water surface, a horizontal wooden bar connected to a small electric motor is creating straight parallel wave crests (plane waves) travelling forward. Below the glass tank, a white sheet of paper on the table shows the alternating bright and dark parallel lines (shadows of crests and troughs). Clean flat textbook illustration, white background.
